_comment: Single source of truth for what the bug finder covers. Edit here, then run: trek_bug_finder.py sync. The workflow script embeds a generated copy of slices; `domains --uncovered` lists tracked source files no slice reads.

slices.what: persistence: SQLite store, search, usage, checkpoints, rewind, lineage, transcripts, core types
focus: SQLite migrations and transaction boundaries
Search and usage queries on odd input
Checkpoint, rewind and lineage consistency after a crash or partial write

slices.what: settings, agent registry and catalog, paths, detection of installed tools, skills, MCP config, open-in, winget, elevation, process handling, limits, git and worktrees
focus: Skill origin and source classification, disable and enable round trips
Settings salvage: unknown keys survive a save, removed keys do not come back
Keychain and secrets fallback, environment variable keys
Path traversal and filesystem safety, cross-device moves

slices.what: agent update parsing, Trek self-update and relocation, changelog, feeds, pricing, verification; the trek-update helper binary
imports from Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode history; Basecamp; notes; artifacts and their CSP; visualizations; inline edits; orchestration; hunks and changes; restating
the agent adapters: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ACP, direct API, mock; limits, status, titles, stop handling
focus: Streaming SSE chunking and error termination
Anthropic thinking blocks and signatures across turns
Dynamic model discovery per provider wire (headers, endpoints, cache)
Rate-limit reset parsing: dates, zones, durations, parentheses
ACP and CLI process spawning, stdin and stdout pipes, stop handling

slices.what: the phone link: pairing, TLS, host, server, protocol, the Mac side of the link and push notifications
focus: Socket reconnection and authentication
Pairing and TLS edge cases
Address advertising on odd networks (IPv6-only, link-local, VPN)

slices.what: trek-mcp (computer use, simulator, orchestrate, desktop, keys), trek-ipc, the app IPC, deep links, single instance, the editor extension
focus: JSON-RPC serialisation and error responses
Stdio communication and hung child processes

slices.what: the workspace model and root window: thread lifecycle, turns, projects, windows, tabs
focus: Async runtime tasks and GPUI updates
Race conditions during rapid thread switching
Model fetching concurrency and in-flight state
Process cleanup on window close

slices.what: thread view, composer, mentions, attachments, agent updates, working bar, trail words, activity, changes card, jobs, cost
focus: Picker index bounds and keyboard wrapping
Empty list and loading states, custom model query row
Key event capture and paste handling

slices.what: the IDE: explorer, terminal, preview, browser, editor, LSP client, languages, worktree UI
panels, sidebar, command palette, keys and shortcuts, Basecamp view
math, visualizations, markdown, artifact web views, note images and notes UI, image preview, formatting and time
settings UI, onboarding, add agent, integrations, updater, tray, toasts, dictation, screen clips, system and window code, main, logging, perf, shots
focus: Pickers and pages reading state that fetches model lists
Updater swap and relaunch

slices.what: look and feel: brand, palette, fonts, motion, chrome, mascot, file icons, the shared UI helpers, embedded assets, the background strip
focus: Embedded asset lookups that can miss or panic
Animation state that never ends or restarts on every render
Theme colour maths on edge values

slices.what: build, bundle, release, install and verification shell scripts; build.rs; Cargo manifests; the benchmark and seed examples in trek-core
